import numpy as np
v0=0.5 # m/s nominal drive
latencies=np.array([0.2,0.5,1.0,2.0])
a_brake=2.0 # m/s2 conservative skid-steer brake decel
for T in latencies:
    d_coast=v0*T
    d_brake=v0**2/(2*a_brake)
    print(f"T={T}s coast={d_coast:.3f} m brake={d_brake:.4f} m total={d_coast+d_brake:.3f} m")
# time history for 0.5 s timeout
dt=0.02; T=0.5; t=np.arange(0,1.2,dt)
x=np.zeros_like(t)
v=np.zeros_like(t); v[0]=v0
braking=False
for i in range(1,len(t)):
    if t[i]>T:
        v[i]=max(0,v[i-1]-a_brake*dt)
    else:
        v[i]=v0
    x[i]=x[i-1]+v[i]*dt
print(f"final stop x={x[-1]:.3f} m t_stop={T+v0/a_brake:.2f} s")
